dedupe_keys.name: a connected building landscape dataset for instance segmentation

description: A Connected Building Landscape dataset for Instance Segmentation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zhihao Zheng et al. To address the scarcity of high-quality instance segmentation data for the unique architecture of high-density East Asian cities, this paper introduces the Connected Building Landscape dataset, a resource for urban planning, architectural analysis, and computer vision tasks. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: JSON, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
